body:
Founder real-time, live report against a real screenshot: 'no robots tho' -- every character rendering as a plain box body. Root cause #1: gband_shader_and_mesh_init returned early on tyler_body load failure, incorrectly blocking the unrelated robot-kit loading below it -- pre-existing control-flow bug since S144-02 Stage B, fixed to fall through instead of returning. Root cause #2: ShankPit_Client_*.zip release packaging never bundled assets/ at all, so every relative-path asset load failed unconditionally on any real machine running the distributed client -- also pre-existing since S144-02 Stage B, fixed by copying assets/ into the zip. Neither bug is new to this session; both were only surfaced now because a real user ran the actual packaged client and reported back with a screenshot. Commits: 3ae1f4f, d86638f, 3af9e7d.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed two real, pre-existing bugs blocking all robots (and tyler_body) in the real client
